scope: Janus Habitat provenance and shadow retention

recovered_at_origin.finding: Minimize Surprise can accidentally become anomaly suppression if used as truth objective.
Destroying original files after assimilation destroys primary provenance and can make later reverse verification impossible.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Preserve original bytes or immutable/content-addressed source reference; deletion requires explicit owner authority.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Labeling successful entropy-minimization patterns as Truths over-promotes internal success.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Store typed observations, hypotheses, survivors, validated candidates, receipts, negative results and unresolved states; internal success != world truth.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Instantaneous collapse/delete of non-winning hypotheses destroys countermodels and weakens reverse analysis.
recovered_at_origin.repair: COMMIT_WITH_SHADOW_PRESERVATION; retain rejected alternatives with reasons and allow reactivation on fresh evidence.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Dream/internal-noise material could contaminate observation or predictive-label memory if not isolated.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Synthetic origin label + sandbox; no evidence, command, predictive-label or predictive-training authority.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Ouroboros hash mismatch followed by autonomous Mutate/Repair can turn integrity checking into unbounded self-modification.
recovered_at_origin.repair: DETECT -> QUARANTINE -> COMPARE_KNOWN_GOOD -> PROPOSE_REPAIR -> VERIFY -> OWNER_OR_SIGNED_CAPABILITY_GATE -> APPLY_OR_HOLD.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Always-listening syslog and wormhole ingestion must remain untrusted data channels, not command channels.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Rate/size limits, fail-closed parse, prompt-injection authority=false, syslog_text_is_command=false.

recovered_at_origin.finding: v2.0 used two workers and a shared launch barrier but recorded lane intervals that could execute without actual in-flight overlap; 'simultaneous' was too strong.
recovered_at_origin.repair: v2.1 uses two POSIX processes with start/active/finish barriers and requires process-level in-flight overlap witness; instruction-level simultaneity is explicitly not claimed.

recovered_at_origin.finding: v2.0 JOIN could accept two passing lanes without requiring distinct evidence on non-center pairs.
recovered_at_origin.repair: NON_CENTER_EVIDENCE_DIVERSITY_REQUIRED; center gate may share evidence; diversity is explicitly not proof of independence.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Merging directional candidates without preserving both shadows loses information needed by reverse recovery.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Every pair receipt now archives both directional candidate hashes and permits reactivation with new evidence.

remaining_boundaries: Thermodynamic language remains a software architecture metaphor unless physical telemetry and a formal model establish a physical interpretation.
The 150 W field in the uploaded source is configuration text, not measured runtime power evidence.
Cognitive Pain is treated as a scheduler/resource-pressure metaphor, not a sentience claim.
GitHub Actions validates software control paths; it does not establish physical NAS/PC/ESP32/Echo-Pyramid runtime behavior.
Process-level overlap proves overlapping in-flight worker intervals, not simultaneous CPU instruction execution.
Internal PASS does not establish causal or world truth; fresh external validation remains required.
next_gate: THERMODYNAMIC_SIGNAL_RUNTIME_V1: bind measured resource telemetry and anomaly-interest budgeting without granting epistemic authority, then adversarially test stale-source, dream-leakage, hash-mismatch and directional-evidence-correlation negatives.
